method: cad.inspect measurements and collision analysis; cad.look visual review

visual_review.finding: Four distinct parts; arched handle, double-belly fluted shade, exposed upper liner ring, rear lower wire openings and three shade magnet pockets are visible.

limits: No physical printing or fit trial performed.
Shade nominal wall is radial 1.8 mm, locally thickened by flutes; no claim of uniform normal wall thickness.
Magnet holding force, adhesive durability, light temperature and translucency require a physical prototype.
Original lamp electrical ratings and connector identity are not provided; retain original wiring and matched supply.
